# Solcaya — Private Studio for Bespoke DJ Mixes

Solcaya is a private studio composing bespoke DJ mixes by hand for weddings, private estates, and flagship evenings. Each commission is curated around the client's taste and occasion, with discreet and white-label delivery available.

## Key pages
- Home: https://solcaya.com/ — studio overview and bespoke-mix approach.
- Commission tiers and pricing: https://solcaya.com/#collection — Sol ($197), Caya ($397), and Solcaya (from $750).
- Studio/about: https://solcaya.com/#about — the studio's approach and discretion commitments.
- Audio samples: https://solcaya.com/#samples — selected bespoke mix examples.
- Process: https://solcaya.com/#process — consultation, composition, refinement, and delivery.
- Journal index: https://solcaya.com/journal/ — practical guidance on bespoke mixes, wedding music, and private-event sound.
- Journal — cocktail-hour music: https://solcaya.com/journal/how-to-choose-wedding-cocktail-hour-music — choosing personal, conversation-friendly wedding music.
- Journal — custom mix pricing: https://solcaya.com/journal/how-much-does-a-custom-dj-mix-cost — commission tiers, scope, and delivery.
- Journal — first-dance song: https://solcaya.com/journal/how-to-choose-your-first-dance-song — selecting a first-dance song and planning playback.
- Journal — bespoke mix or playlist: https://solcaya.com/journal/bespoke-mix-vs-playlist — differences between a hand-composed mix and playlist.
- Journal — private-estate music: https://solcaya.com/journal/music-for-private-estates — planning music across a private event.
- Private inquiry / booking: https://solcaya.com/#inquire — submit a commission brief.
- Terms: https://solcaya.com/terms/terms — terms of service.
